title: Golden Ticket
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael launches a Willy Wonka Golden Ticket promotion to boost sales, but complications arise when all the golden tickets end up with a single client, Blue Cross, risking a large discount loss. Meanwhile, Dwight and Michael argue over who originated the idea, leading to tension and a marketing meeting arranged by David Wallace. Kevin receives advice on how to approach a girl he likes, and Dwight and Jim engage in humorous antics while planning to visit more houses. The episode explores themes of credit, initiative, and interpersonal dynamics within the office.
